modes.definition_zh: 不依赖经典训诂或外在权威，而是通过内心的体认直接把握宇宙本体天理。吾学虽有所受，天理二字却是自家体贴出来——强调道德本体不是外部给予的规范，而是主体通过反思直觉直接体证的内在本性。此法是程颢认识论与本体论的核心创新：将理从外在规范转化为内在本体，使道德判断获得了主体性的根基。
modes.definition_en: Rather than relying on classical exegesis or external authority, one directly apprehends the cosmic ground — Tianli (Heavenly Principle) — through inner intuitive reflection. Though my learning has its sources, the two characters Heavenly Principle were myself personally tasted out. The method transforms li from an external norm into an immanent ontological ground, giving moral judgment a subject-centered foundation. This is Cheng Hao's core innovation in epistemology and ontology: moral normativity is not imposed from without but discovered within.
process_zh: 悬置外在权威与经典注解
通过内心反思直觉体认天理
将天理确认为道德本体的内在根据
以体认所得为行动的最终依据
process_en: Suspend external authority and classical commentaries
Apprehend Tianli through inner intuitive reflection
Establish Tianli as the immanent ground of moral normativity
Take the intuited principle as the ultimate criterion for action
modes.key_quote_zh: 吾学虽有所受，天理二字却是自家体贴出来。
modes.key_quote_en: Though my learning has its sources, the two characters Heavenly Principle were personally tasted out by me.
representative_cases_zh: 程颢自述天理二字却是自家体贴出来，标志着儒学从汉唐注疏传统向宋明心性传统的根本转向
程颢批评汉代经学家以训诂为学，主张学莫先于立志——立志即是体认天理
反例警示：若把体贴理解为神秘主义的直觉体验，则会错失程颢的经验根基——体贴始终指向伦理实践而非纯粹认知
representative_cases_en: Cheng Hao's claim that the two characters Heavenly Principle were personally tasted out marks the fundamental shift from Han-Tang philological tradition to Song-Ming mind-nature tradition
He criticized Han scholars for making glosses the object of study, insisting that learning must begin with setting one's heart on the Way — which is precisely the intuitive apprehension of Tianli
Counterexample: reading intuitive tasting as mystical experience misses Cheng's empirical grounding — the method always points toward ethical practice, not pure cognition

modes.domain_zh: 生态伦理学/共同体意识
modes.definition_zh: 以仁为贯通天人的本体，主张人与天地万物本为一体。医书言手足痿痹为不仁，同理，若觉万物与我分离，便是不仁。仁者视天下犹一家，中国犹一人，打破小我与大我的界限。此法是程颢伦理学与宇宙论的交汇点：仁不仅是人际道德，更是存在论意义上的贯通。
modes.definition_en: Taking ren (benevolence) as the ground that connects heaven and humanity, this method holds that person and all things under heaven are originally one body. Medical texts say numbness of limbs is called not-ren; likewise, if one feels severed from all things, that is not-ren. The benevolent person sees the world as one family and the state as one body, breaking the boundary between small self and great self. This is Cheng Hao's intersection of ethics and cosmology: ren is not merely interpersonal morality but ontological connectivity.
process_zh: 识别躯壳上起念的小我隔阂
通过推扩仁心消解人与万物的界限
体验天上地下唯我独尊的大快活
将关怀扩展至天地万物
process_en: Identify the narrow self centered on the physical body
Expand benevolent concern to dissolve boundaries between person and all things
Experience the great joy of nothing between heaven and earth except myself
Extend care to encompass all under heaven
modes.key_quote_zh: 仁者，浑然与物同体。义、礼、知、信皆仁也。
modes.key_quote_en: The benevolent person is浑然 integrated with all things. Righteousness, ritual, wisdom, and trustworthiness are all expressions of ren.
representative_cases_zh: 程颢以医家痿痹不仁为喻：手足麻木不知痛痒谓之不仁，人与万物隔绝漠不关心亦是不仁
程颢观鸡雏可以观仁——从生命的蓬勃生机中体认宇宙本体
反例警示：若把万物一体理解为取消差异的同一，便会滑向泛神论——程颢强调的是在差异中见统一，而非消灭差异
representative_cases_en: Cheng Hao uses the medical metaphor of numbness: limbs unresponsive to pain are not-ren; similarly, indifference to all things is not-ren
His observing chicks can reveal ren — apprehending the cosmic ground through the vitality of life
Counterexample: reading all things as one as the erasure of difference leads to pantheism — Cheng stresses unity-in-difference, not the elimination of distinction

modes.domain_zh: 修养方法论/目标优先级
modes.definition_zh: 学问工夫首要在于识仁——先立其大，体认仁体。一旦识得仁体，义礼智信皆仁之发用，不须防检，不须穷索，只以诚敬存之即可。此为先立其大的入门路径，区别于程颐格物穷理的渐进积累。
modes.definition_en: The primary task of learning and cultivation is recognizing ren — first establish the great part, apprehend the ground of benevolence. Once the ground of ren is recognized, righteousness, ritual, wisdom, and trustworthiness are all its expressions; no need for vigilance or exhaustive inquiry — simply maintain it through sincerity and reverence. This is the first establish the great approach, distinct from Cheng Yi's gradual accumulation via investigating things.
process_zh: 确立学问的首要目标是识仁而非积学
通过直觉体认把握仁体（万物一体之觉）
以诚敬存养此体，使其常明不忘
由仁体发用诸德，不须外求
process_en: Establish that the primary goal of learning is recognizing ren, not accumulating knowledge
Apprehend the ground of ren through intuitive recognition
Nurture this ground through sincerity and reverence, keeping it bright and unforgetful
Let all virtues flow from the ground of ren, without seeking externally
modes.key_quote_zh: 学者须先识仁。仁者，浑然与物同体。识得此理，以诚敬存之而已，不须防检，不须穷索。
modes.key_quote_en: The student must first recognize ren. Ren is浑然 integrated with all things. Once this principle is recognized, simply maintain it through sincerity and reverence — no need for vigilance, no need for exhaustive inquiry.
representative_cases_zh: 程颢《识仁篇》开宗明义：学者须先识仁，将仁确立为学问工夫的首要目标
与朱熹今日格一物，明日格一物的渐进路径形成对照——程颢强调先立乎其大者
反例警示：若把识仁理解为一次性顿悟而忽略持续存养，则会落入禅宗一念顿悟的空疏——程颢同时强调诚敬存之的持续工夫
representative_cases_en: Cheng Hao's Recognizing Ren opens with the student must first recognize ren, establishing ren as the primary goal of cultivation
Contrast with Zhu Xi's gradual path of investigating one thing today, another tomorrow — Cheng emphasizes first establish the great

Counterexample: reading recognizing ren as a one-time enlightenment while neglecting continuous nurturing falls into Chan Buddhism's empty sudden enlightenment — Cheng simultaneously insists on the sustained work of maintaining through sincerity and reverence
modern_applications_zh: 目标设定与优先级管理

modes.definition_zh: 定性的真正含义是动亦定，静亦定——不是通过压抑情感或隔绝外物来求得内心的平静，而是通过廓然大公，物来顺应使心体自然安定。将迎、内外之分皆是病根，君子之学当无将迎、无内外。此法回应张载定性未能不动，犹累于外物的困惑。
modes.definition_en: The true meaning of stabilizing nature is stable in motion, stable in stillness — not by suppressing emotions or isolating from external things, but by being broadly and impartially open, responding appropriately to what comes so that the mind-ground naturally settles. The dichotomy of anticipating and receiving (jiangying), and the split between internal and external, are the root of the problem. The gentleman's learning has neither anticipation nor exclusion, neither internal nor external.
process_zh: 识别以内为内、以外为外的二分病根
通过廓然大公消除内外对立
培养对情境的敏锐感知，使情感反应恰如其分
达到动亦定，静亦定的自然安定状态
process_en: Identify the pathological dichotomy of internal as internal, external as external
Dissolve the internal-external opposition through broad impartial openness
Cultivate acute sensitivity to situations so emotional responses are appropriate
Reach the natural stable state of stable in motion, stable in stillness
modes.key_quote_zh: 夫天地之常，以其心普万物而无心；圣人之常，以其情顺万物而无情。故君子之学，莫若廓然而大公，物来而顺应。
modes.key_quote_en: The constant way of heaven and earth is to extend its heart to all things without having a partial heart; the constant way of the sage is to let his feelings follow all things without having partial feelings. Therefore in the learning of the gentleman, nothing is better than being broadly and impartially open, and responding appropriately to what comes.
representative_cases_zh: 程颢答张载问定性：圣人以物之当喜为喜，以物之当怒为怒——情感不是主观偏好，而是对事物之当的恰当回应
无将迎，无内外——不预先期待，也不刻意排斥，让心体自然应物
反例警示：若把定性理解为压抑情感或追求绝对平静，则会陷入斯多葛式的不动心（apatheia）——程颢追求的是恰如其分的情感，而非情感的消除
representative_cases_en: Cheng Hao's response to Zhang Zai on stabilizing nature: the sage takes as joy what ought to be joyful, takes as anger what ought to be angry — emotions are not subjective preferences but appropriate responses to what things demand
Neither anticipating nor receiving, neither internal nor external — do not preconceive, nor deliberately exclude; let the mind-ground naturally respond to things
Counterexample: reading stabilizing nature as emotion suppression or pursuit of absolute calmness leads to Stoic apatheia — Cheng seeks appropriately measured emotion, not emotion elimination

modes.domain_en: Theory of Human Nature / Moral Metaphysics
modes.definition_zh: 人性之本然（天命之性）即是天理，至善而无恶。人之恶源于气禀之偏——气有清浊厚薄，故有人之贤愚善恶差异。去恶复善之工夫在于变化气质，使气禀回归天命之性的本然状态。此法是理学人性论的形上学根基。
modes.definition_en: Human nature in its original state (mingtian zhi xing) is identical to Tianli — perfectly good and without evil. Human evil derives from qi endowment (qibin) being skewed — qi varies in clarity and density, explaining differences in human worth and moral character. The work of eliminating evil and restoring goodness lies in transforming qi endowment so that it returns to the original state of mingtian zhi xing. This is the metaphysical foundation of Li-xue's theory of human nature.
process_zh: 区分天命之性（本然至善）与气禀之性（现实有偏）
理解恶的来源是气禀之偏而非性之本然
通过修养工夫变化气质，使气禀回归天命之性
在现实中实践复性工夫
process_en: Distinguish mingtian zhi xing (original perfect goodness) from qibin zhi xing (reality with bias)
Understand that evil stems from qi skew, not from nature's original state
Transform qi endowment through cultivation so it returns to mingtian zhi xing
Practice the work of restoring nature in daily life
modes.key_quote_zh: 性即理也，何止性，天道也。
modes.key_quote_en: Nature is identical to principle — not only nature, but the Way of heaven itself.
representative_cases_zh: 程颢区分天命之性与气禀之性，解决了孟子性善论与现实中恶的现象之间的矛盾
人生气禀，理有善恶——恶不是性之本然，而是气禀之偏
反例警示：若把气禀理解为固定的命运决定论，则会陷入消极宿命——程颢同时强调变化气质的可能与必要
representative_cases_en: Cheng Hao distinguishes mingtian zhi xing from qibin zhi xing, resolving the contradiction between Mencius' theory of innate goodness and the reality of evil
When people are born, qi endowment has good and evil — evil is not the original state of nature but a skew of qi
Counterexample: reading qi endowment as fixed fatalism leads to消极 determinism — Cheng simultaneously emphasizes the possibility and necessity of transforming qi endowment
modern_applications_zh: 教育理念的形上学基础
道德教育的本体论支撑
modern_applications_en: Human nature assumptions and organizational design

modes.definition_zh: 天地之大德曰生，宇宙的根本特征是生生不息。万物之生意（生机、生命力）是最可观的，此即仁。观鸡雏可观仁，观窗前草可知造物生意——从生命现象中体认天道，是道德直觉的培养路径。此法是程颢宇宙论与伦理学的桥梁。
modes.definition_en: The great virtue of heaven and earth is generation — the fundamental characteristic of the cosmos is ceaseless vital generation. The shengyi (vital energy, life force) of all things is most worthy of observation, and this is ren. Observing chicks reveals ren; observing grass before the window reveals the creative vitality of heaven and earth — apprehending the heavenly Way through life phenomena is the path of cultivating moral intuition. This is Cheng Hao's bridge between cosmology and ethics.
process_zh: 观察生命现象（如鸡雏、草木）
从生机勃勃中体认天地之大德
将生机体认与仁德关联
在日常中保持对生命力的敏感
process_en: Observe life phenomena (such as chicks, grass)
Apprehend the great virtue of heaven and earth from vibrant vitality
Connect the apprehension of vitality with ren (benevolence)
Maintain sensitivity to life force in daily practice
modes.key_quote_zh: 万物之生意最可观，此元者善之长也，斯所谓仁也。
modes.key_quote_en: The vital energy of all things is most worthy of observation — this is the chief of the good, what is called ren.
representative_cases_zh: 程颢观鸡雏可以观仁——鸡雏象征新生，体现宇宙生命的健动不息
程颢窗前有草，不除去，问之云：欲常见造物生意——从日常草木中体认天道
反例警示：若把生生理解为生物学意义上的繁殖，则会错失其形上学意义——程颢的生是宇宙本体的动态展现，而非单纯的生命现象
representative_cases_en: Cheng Hao observing chicks can reveal ren — chicks symbolize new birth, reflecting the relentless vitality of the cosmic life
Grass before the window, do not remove — ask why? To frequently observe the creative vitality of heaven and earth — apprehending the heavenly Way from ordinary grass
Counterexample: reading sheng as mere biological reproduction misses its metaphysical significance — Cheng's generation is the dynamic manifestation of the cosmic ground, not merely a life phenomenon

modes.definition_zh: 天地万物之理，无独必有对——任何事物都必然有其对立面，阴阳、动静、消长、善恶皆成对出现。对立面之间相互依存、相互转化，一阴一阳，一善一恶，阳长则阴消，善增则恶减。此法是程颢朴素辩证法思想的核心。
modes.definition_en: The principle of heaven and earth and all things has no singleton but must have its opposite — every thing necessarily has its counterpart: yin and yang, motion and stillness, waxing and waning, good and evil all appear in pairs. Opposites mutually depend on and transform into each other: one yin one yang, one good one evil, as yang grows yin fades, as good increases evil diminishes. This is the core of Cheng Hao's naive dialectical thought.
process_zh: 识别任何现象必有其对立面
理解对立面之间的相互依存关系
观察对立面之间的消长转化
在对立统一中把握事物的完整面貌
process_en: Recognize that every phenomenon necessarily has its opposite
Understand the mutual dependence between opposites
Observe the waxing-waning transformation between opposites
Grasp the complete picture of things through unity of opposites
modes.key_quote_zh: 天地万物之理，无独必有对，皆自然而然，非有安排也。
modes.key_quote_en: The principle of heaven and earth and all things — there is no singleton, it must have its opposite; all is natural, not arranged by any hand.
representative_cases_zh: 程颢每中夜以思，不知手之舞之足之蹈之也——发现理必有对时的欣喜，显示此发现的革命性
一阴一阳之谓道——阴阳不是两个实体，而是同一理的两种表现形态
反例警示：若把对理解为僵化的二元对立，则会错失程颢的动态辩证法——对立面是相互转化的，不是静止的对立
representative_cases_en: Cheng Hao every midnight I ponder and cannot help dancing with hands and stamping with feet — the joy of discovering principle must have opposites shows the revolutionary nature of this insight
One yin one yang is called the Way — yin and yang are not two entities but two manifestations of the same principle
Counterexample: reading opposites as rigid binary opposition misses Cheng's dynamic dialectic — opposites are mutually transforming, not statically opposed

modes.name_en: Cultivating Reverence and Righteousness Together Method
modes.definition_zh: 敬以直内，义以方外——内在以恭敬涵养心性（直内），外在以正义规范行为（方外）。敬与义不可偏废：有敬无义则流于虚静，有义无敬则失之支离。敬义立而德不孤。此法是程颢修养论的操作框架。
modes.definition_en: Reverence makes the interior straight, righteousness squares the exterior — internally cultivate the mind-nature through reverence (straightening the inner), externally regulate behavior through righteousness (squaring the outer). Neither reverence nor righteousness can be neglected: reverence without righteousness flows into empty stillness; righteousness without reverence loses coherence. When reverence and righteousness are established, virtue is not isolated.
process_zh: 以敬涵养内心——使心专一、不散乱
以义规范行为——使行为合乎时宜
保持敬义的动态平衡，避免偏废
达到内外合一、敬义不二的境界
process_en: Nourish the inner mind through reverence — keep the mind focused, unscattered
Regulate outward behavior through righteousness — make actions appropriate to circumstances
Maintain dynamic balance between reverence and righteousness, avoiding neglect of either
Reach the境界 of inner-outer unity where reverence and righteousness are not two
modes.key_quote_zh: 敬以直内，义以方外。敬义立而德不孤。
modes.key_quote_en: Reverence makes the interior straight, righteousness squares the exterior. When reverence and righteousness are established, virtue is not isolated.
representative_cases_zh: 程颢强调敬义只是一事——内外本不二，敬本身就是义的基础，义本身就是敬的体现
与禅家空静对比：有敬无义则流于虚静，有义无敬则失之支离
反例警示：若把敬义理解为先后工序（先敬后义或先义后敬），则会错失其同时性——敬义本是一事的两面
representative_cases_en: Cheng Hao emphasizes reverence and righteousness are but one thing — inner and outer are not two; reverence itself is the ground of righteousness, righteousness itself is the manifestation of reverence
Contrast with Chan emptiness: reverence without righteousness flows into empty stillness; righteousness without reverence loses coherence
Counterexample: reading reverence and righteousness as sequential steps (first reverence then righteousness, or vice versa) misses their simultaneity — they are two aspects of one reality
modern_applications_zh: 个人修养与职业伦理的结合
modern_applications_en: Integration of personal cultivation and professional ethics

modes.name_en: Heaven and Humanity as One Source Method
modes.definition_zh: 天人本无二，不必言合——天与人不是两个可以合起来的独立实体，而是同一本体的不同显现。以人合天的说法本身已预设了天人二分，是错误的。天道即人道，人道即天道。此法是程颢对传统天人合一命题的根本修正。
modes.definition_en: Heaven and humanity are originally not two; there is no need to speak of union — heaven and humanity are not two independent entities that can be joined; they are different manifestations of the same ground. To speak of uniting humanity with heaven already presupposes a heaven-humanity duality, which is erroneous. The Way of heaven is the Way of humanity; the Way of humanity is the Way of heaven. This is Cheng Hao's fundamental correction of the traditional heaven-humanity unity proposition.
process_zh: 识别天人合一说法中的二元预设
理解天道与人道本是一源
在具体实践中体认天人的不可分离
以整体性思维替代二分思维
process_en: Identify the dualistic presupposition in heaven-humanity union language
Understand that the Way of heaven and the Way of humanity share one source
Apprehend the inseparability of heaven and humanity in concrete practice
Replace dualistic thinking with holistic thinking
modes.key_quote_zh: 天人本无二，不必言合。道一也，岂人道自是人道，天道自是天道？
modes.key_quote_en: Heaven and humanity are originally not two; there is no need to speak of union. The Way is one — how could the human Way be merely human and the heavenly Way be merely heavenly?
representative_cases_zh: 程颢批评以人合天的说法预设了天人的分离——但他并不否认天人之间的关系，只是认为这种关系不应被理解为两个实体的结合
道未始有天人之别——道在天地之间无所不在，在天为天道，在人为人道
反例警示：若把天人一本理解为取消天的超越性，则会陷入自然主义——程颢同时强调天理的超越性与内在性的统一
representative_cases_en: Cheng Hao criticizes the uniting humanity with heaven formulation for presupposing heaven-humanity separation — yet he does not deny their relationship, only insists it should not be understood as the joining of two entities
The Way has never distinguished between heaven and humanity — the Way is everywhere in heaven and earth; in heaven it is the heavenly Way, in humanity it is the human Way

Counterexample: reading heaven-humanity as one source as the elimination of heaven's transcendence leads to naturalism — Cheng simultaneously emphasizes the unity of transcendence and immanence of Tianli
modern_applications_zh: 破除专业壁垒的系统思考

modes.definition_zh: 君子之学，必至圣人而后己。不至圣人而自己者，皆弃也。圣人是学问的最高典范与终极目标，学道须以圣人为标则，不以成圣为目标者皆视为自我放弃。圣人不是可望不可即的神话，而是人人可通过修养抵达的境界。此法是程颢教育哲学的最高原则。
modes.definition_en: The learning of the gentleman must aim at becoming a sage; to fall short of the sage and stop at oneself is to abandon oneself. The sage is the highest model and ultimate goal of learning — one must take the sage as standard; anyone who does not aim at sagehood is considered to have abandoned themselves. The sage is not an unreachable myth but a境界 accessible to all through cultivation. This is Cheng Hao's highest principle of educational philosophy.
process_zh: 确立圣人作为学问的终极目标
以圣人为标则评估自己的进步
理解圣人可学而至，非遥不可及
在实践中不断朝向圣人境界努力
process_en: Establish the sage as the ultimate goal of learning
Take the sage as the standard to evaluate one's progress
Understand that sagehood is achievable through learning, not unreachable
Strive continuously toward the sage's境界 in practice
modes.key_quote_zh: 君子之学，必至圣人而后己。不至圣人而自己者，皆弃也。
modes.key_quote_en: The learning of the gentleman must reach the sage before stopping; to stop short of the sage and content oneself is self-abandonment.
representative_cases_zh: 程颢强调圣人可学而致——与苏轼等人的才学路径不同，程颢强调的是品格与境界的成就
程颢的圣人观既有超越性（圣人气象）又有现实性（圣人可学），既是对古代圣王的追溯又是对个体修养的激励
反例警示：若把圣人标则理解为完美主义，会导致自我苛责——程颢同时强调颜子陋巷不改其乐，圣人境界包含内在的快乐
representative_cases_en: Cheng Hao emphasizes the sage can be reached through learning — unlike Su Shi's talent-learning path, Cheng stresses the achievement of character and境界
Cheng's view of the sage has both transcendence (sage's demeanor) and reality (sagehood is learnable); it is both a追溯 to ancient sage-kings and an激励 to individual cultivation
Counterexample: reading sage as standard as perfectionism leads to self-harshness — Cheng simultaneously emphasizes Yan Hui in his简陋 lane did not change his joy; the sage's境界 includes inner joy
